neighbours.label: forms of the verb 'come' (' coming', ' come', ' came', Chinese/Japanese 来): the motion-toward verb itself; the same sentences with 'go', 'went' or 'arrive' stay near zero
fire: My aunt said she is coming to visit us at Easter.
When the bus finally came, the stop was crowded with students.
Could you come to the meeting a few minutes early?
Rain clouds were coming in fast from the west.
Thousands of fans came out to greet the team at the airport.
下周我的朋友会来我家吃饭。
Everyone knew that winter was coming soon in the valley.
The kids came running when they heard the ice-cream van.
quiet: My aunt said she is going to visit them at Easter.
When the bus finally left, the stop was crowded with students.
Could you attend the meeting a few minutes early?

Thousands of fans went out to greet the team at the airport.
下周我的朋友会去他家吃饭。
Everyone knew that winter was starting soon in the valley.
The kids went running when they heard the ice-cream van.

notes: Card: peak tokens ' coming' x8, 来 x7, 來 x5, ' Coming', ' came'; + pole promotes come forms. Probe: 'Is coming to the office' 0.690, 他…来上海 0.548, 'the coming weekend' 0.539, 'come over' 0.483, 'coming out' 0.424, 'came home' 0.339; 'next weekend' 0.013, 'went home' 0.003.
